messages:
Ravi K. (People Ops): Heads-up thread for Aisha Mbaye's onsite in London on Tue Oct 3. Shes arriving LHR 07:40 local time from Dakar. Need: interview windows, transit reimbursement instructions (international), lactation room booking, vegetarian lunch, and a Teams fallback if customs delays.
Liam S. (Recruiter): Aisha requested a mellow schedule 3:00-16:00 BST preferred but she can do earlier if needed. Wants a 30m break between technical and culture loops. No allergies, vegetarian.
Dana W. (Hiring Manager): I can do 14:00-15:30. Prefer interview split: 45m system design, 45m behavioral.
Priya M. (Office Admin): I can reserve Room 4 (2nd floor) and the Lactation Room (keycard provided). I'll order a vegetarian lunch box and tea. Also confirm whether she'll need a visitor badge and transit card.
Liam S. (Recruiter): I'll ask Aisha about Visitor badge name spelling and whether she wants an Oyster preloaded (we reimburse up to \u00A360).
Ravi K. (People Ops): Reimbursement policy refresher: international candidates  we reimburse travel + visa-related incidental up to agreed cap. Originals preferred; scanned receipts OK via email to travel@redwood.example within 45 days. For foreign currency, include a short note: "amount in currency X, converted to GBP at date Y, rate source e.g., xe.com". Taxi cap LHR->office  pre-approved up to \u00A360.
Dana W. (Hiring Manager): Teams fallback please  can ops-bot create a meeting link and put it in the calendar event? Also I'll join 10 min early.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Aisha Mbaye" Tue Oct 3 14:00:00 BST  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=lkjhgfd (rooms: Room 4 + Lactation Room). Teams fallback link: https://teams.redwood.example/meet/aa1b2c
Priya M. (Office Admin): Badge ready  name: Aisha Mbaye. Liam, please confirm passport name for badge. Oyster note: I'll preload \u00A335 for initial travel unless you ask otherwise.
Liam S. (Recruiter): Confirmed passport name matches. Aisha says shed appreciate the preloaded Oyster. I'll send itinerary, travel & expenses steps, and lactation room directions 48h prior.
Ravi K. (People Ops): Sample expense snippet to send candidate (paste into email):
```
Item: Taxi LHR->Office
Amount: 28,000 XOF
Convert: 28,000 XOF = \u00A332.40 GBP (rate xe.com on 2026-10-02)
Attach: original receipt (photo fine)
Submit: travel@redwood.example within 45 days
```
Priya M. (Office Admin): Lactation Room sign-out sheet printed; Quiet Room labelled. Catering placed for 15:00.
Dana W. (Hiring Manager): I'll prepare the panel and share a short prompt set (behavioral + system design) 24h before. Panel please join 5 min early.
Liam S. (Recruiter): Sending candidate message now with itinerary, Teams fallback, Oyster info, and expenses checklist. CC travel@redwood.example. Will update if ETA changes. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Ravi K. (People Ops): Great  keeping this as day-of ops thread. Ping here for any last-minute changes. :calendar:
